metadata.evidence: It is costly to retrain an LLM model like BloombergGPT every month or every week, thus lightweight adaptation is highly favorable. FinGPT can be fine-tuned swiftly to incorporate new data (the cost falls significantly, less than **$300 per fine-tuning**).
metadata.reason: Highlights the significant cost reduction and economic accessibility compared to training proprietary financial LLMs.

metadata.evidence: Best trainable and inferable FinGPT for sentiment analysis on a single RTX 3090, which is even better than GPT-4 and ChatGPT Finetuning.
metadata.reason: Specifies accessible consumer-grade GPU requirements for fine-tuning, lowering the barrier to entry for researchers and practitioners.
